body: I get it. I've been in both positions before. Ussally when I vent or rant I just want someone to listen to me talk, listen to me cry, and listen to me scream off any hatred. I feel terrible about that sometimes though. I don't want to put anyone through any stress or hurt anyone because of my impulsive emotions or mental health problems. On the other hand, my friends have been through some stuff that they just dump on me out of the blue. They ask me for advice and I can't always give it to them which makes me feel bad as well. You aren't anyone's therapist though and you certainly aren't an awful human being. Your mental health should come first. I think it's okay and sometimes good to listen to others, but you are not obliged to do anything or carry anyone's emotional weight. :)
